fields.Name: CRD-08 - Subject isolation
fields.Description: Verify the subject boundary of the nine applicant-data entities: contacts read only their own subject's rows and staff only their organization's subjects' rows; another subject's ID is refused exactly like a random one; a direct save or delete is refused for every caller while an operation write succeeds as the caller; a contact reads no authoring entity or membership; SubjectAccess reads authoring rows as the system user only after the caller's filter admitted the owned row; the subject lock refuses a waiter with the applicant sentence; and background units on isolated providers serialize on it.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: All nine cred-subject-isolation checks pass, including check 8 using the registered IsolatedProviderFactory.
